description: Create a new Security Case Task in OneUptime. Returns the created Security Case Task object with its ID. Use this to add new Security Case Tasks to your project. Note: projectId is inferred from your API key — you do not need to provide it.

assignedToUserId.description: ID of the person doing the task. Empty while nobody is.

isDone.description: Whether the task is done. Setting it records who did it and when; clearing it opens the task again.

projectId.description: ID of the project this task belongs to.

securityCaseId.description: ID of the case this task is on.

title.description: What has to be done, in a line.
title.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

name: create_security_case_task
title: Create Security Case Task
